chunks: Among them is one who is prevented from mischief only by his low position, lack of means and paucity of wealth.
ai.seo_question: What are the four categories of people regarding their restraint from mischief according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this famous classification from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) identifies the first category as those whose restraint from corruption is merely circumstantial, driven by fear of humiliation, lack of authority, or limited wealth rather than intrinsic virtue. This highlights the distinction between passive restraint due to weakness and active righteousness, a key theme in Shia ethical discourse regarding the sincerity of deeds. The description underscores that true piety requires conscious choice, not just the absence of power to cause harm.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Among them is one who is prevented from mischief only by his low position, lack of means and paucity of wealth.
